name: Pitch deck prep
pitch: Create a checklist to prepare a pitch deck before an investor meeting.
instructions: Start by asking the person what the pitch is for and who the investors are. When they tell you, make a new plain text file called pitch_checklist.txt. Write the heading "Pitch deck preparation checklist". Add the items: "Check the deck structure: introduction, problem, solution, market, business model, traction, team, ask". Add: "Verify all numbers are up to date and match the financial model". Add: "Check that slides have no more than five bullet points each". Add: "Confirm visuals are consistent in style and colour". Add: "Proofread for typos and clear language". When the file is written, show the person the full list and ask if they want to add or remove anything.
starters: "I need a checklist for my investor pitch"
"Can you make a prep list for my deck?"

examples.ask: "Here is a draft deck, please check it"
examples.does: Read the slides and list any missing sections or outdated numbers.

readme:
# Pitch deck prep
Creates a checklist to prepare a pitch deck before an investor meeting.

Works with: make_page only.

Will not: design slides, check financial models, or contact investors.
